ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white central pixels to low-intensity black peripheral and focal pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region across the central span of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the lateral edges and trailing edges, with discrete circular and sub-circular black focal points (mottling) distributed throughout the white field, particularly concentrated on the medial right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern characterized by jagged peaks (5-15 pixels in height) and deep valleys along the entire linear extent of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to high-aspect-ratio tips that sweep upward and outward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast dark-rimmed clusters indicative of barnacle attachment sites, densely populated on the outer lateral tips and scattered across the central ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel linear dark pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed vertically on the medial-right lobe and diagonally on the far-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Yellow-brown chromatic patches (likely diatom film) visible in the lower-central region of both lobes; heavy calcified clusters on the outer lateral leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, asymmetric protrusion on the far-right lateral tip caused by dense barnacle colonization.
